name: Codenames
description: Two teams compete to identify their agents using one-word clues from their spymaster
rules: Two teams compete. Each team has a spymaster and operatives. The spymaster gives a one-word clue plus a number. Operatives guess which board words match the clue. First team to reveal all their words wins. Touch the assassin and you lose instantly.

setup.instruction: Choose your team and role, then click Start

hint.giveClue: Give a clue word and number
hint.waitClue: Waiting for {{team}} to give a clue
